Train a temporal boundary contrast (TBC) model

Source: R/train.R
fb_train.Rd

Fits the two components of TBC on training tiles with reference fields:

  • the edge model, a logistic regression of across versus within pairs on the temporal maximum and mean contrasts of the k selected features (standardised; missing summaries set to the training mean);

  • the cropland model, gradient-boosted trees (xgboost), a probability random forest (ranger) or a logistic regression of field-interior versus background pixels on the 10th, 50th and 90th percentiles and the standard deviation over clear dates of the bands, NDVI, ND(B08,B11) and ND(B11,B12).

Usage

fb_train(
  stacks,
  references,
  features = NULL,
  strata = NULL,
  contrast = NULL,
  k = 8L,
  max_cor = 0.9,
  n_pairs = 4000L,
  n_pixels = 20000L,
  learner = c("xgboost", "ranger", "glm"),
  num_trees = 100L,
  min_node_size = 10L,
  thresholds = list(t_edge = 0.5, t_field = 0.5, min_size = 50L),
  seed = 1L,
  threads = 1L
)

Arguments

stacks

An fb_stack or a list of them (training tiles). For many tiles, list elements may be functions without arguments that return the stack; each tile is then loaded only while it is processed.

references

A reference raster from fb_reference() or a list of them, one per stack (or functions returning them).

features

Candidate features from fb_feature_set(); by default the bands and all normalised differences of the first stack's bands.

strata

Optional stratum label per stack; the AUC is averaged over strata.

contrast

Optional result of fb_rank_contrast() on the same data (avoids recomputing the pair summaries).

k, max_cor

Feature selection settings passed to fb_select_features().

n_pairs

Maximum number of across and of within pairs per stack.

n_pixels

Maximum number of field and of background pixels per stack for the cropland model.

learner

Cropland learner: "xgboost" (gradient-boosted trees, default, as in the validation of the method), "ranger" (random forest) or "glm" (ridge logistic regression).

num_trees

Number of trees (random forest) or boosting rounds (xgboost).

min_node_size

Minimum node size of the random forest; larger values give smaller models.

thresholds

Default object thresholds stored with the model (see fb_delineate()); tune them with fb_tune().

seed

Random seed for pair sampling.

threads

Number of threads for the cropland learner.

Value

An object of class fb_model.

Details

The logistic regressions carry a ridge penalty of 1 on the slopes (the default of scikit-learn's LogisticRegression), which keeps them finite when the classes are separable.

Examples

s <- fb_example_stack("california")
f <- fb_example_files("california")
ref <- fb_reference(sf::st_read(f$fields, quiet = TRUE), s)
m <- fb_train(s, ref, n_pairs = 1000, n_pixels = 2000, num_trees = 50)
m
#> <fb_model> temporal boundary contrast
#>   bands            : B02, B03, B04, B05, B06, B07, B08, B8A, B11, B12 
#>   edge features    : ND(B05,B08) | ND(B06,B08) | ND(B04,B08) | B08 | ND(B03,B08) | B04 | ND(B02,B08) | ND(B05,B8A) 
#>   cropland learner : xgboost 
#>   training         : 1 tiles, 1,034 pairs (34 across), 4,000 pixels
#>   in-sample AUC    : edge 0.998, cropland 1.000
#>   thresholds       : t_edge 0.50, t_field 0.50, min_size 50 pixels
